shared_elements: low-relief carved surface with incised linear detail
justification: The only correspondence is generic: both surfaces carry relief carving with incised parallel striations and a hatched/lattice infill, of the kind used for hair or textile in many traditions. A shows a legible figural scene, a file of standing human figures with pointed caps facing a raised seated/enthroned figure, while B preserves only an abstract fragment of curved striations and a grid, with no identifiable figures, objects or relationships between them.
